title: Warmly Spiced Polish Chicken Breast Casserole
description: A savory and comforting Polish dish featuring chicken breast, warmly spiced with mortar-pestle-pounded spices, suitable for satvik-friendly diets. This casserole is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large bowl, whisk together the paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Add the cooked vegetables and chicken broth to the bowl and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake the casserole for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
